# `foundations/dist/` — AUTO-GENERATED, DO NOT EDIT

The JSON files in this directory are derived by CI from `foundations/src/foundations.md` (Design system lead's MD-as-SoT). Hand edits here are reverted on the next CI run.

## File naming

Starting with v0.4.1 (PR α.5, schema-less derive), **the MD structure determines the output structure**. There is no fixed mapping table — each H3 heading in `foundations.md` becomes one file, named after the slug of the heading text.

Examples:
- `### 2.11 Motion` → `motion.json`
- `### 2.10 Background Tokens` → `background-tokens.json`
- `### Color Usage Rules` → `color-usage-rules.json`

H2 sections with no H3 children get an H2-level emit; H2 sections with both direct prose and H3 children also get a `<slug>-overview.json` for the prose.

To see what files currently exist, read `paths-manifest.json` (the `foundations.*` entries are auto-regenerated by the derive script).

## Special case — `motion.json`

A section whose H4 sub-headings include `Duration` + `Easing` + `Delay` is detected as a "motion-shape" and produces the structured payload (`{ description, tokens: { duration, easing, delay }, patterns: { ... } }`). Detection is by content shape, not section number — authors can renumber/rename the motion section freely.

## To change a token

Edit `foundations/src/foundations.md`. The `foundations-derive.yml` workflow regenerates these JSONs on every PR that touches the source MD or the parser scripts, and posts a semantic-diff comment summarizing what changed.

## How CI writes here

`scripts/foundations/derive-foundations.js` walks the AST of `foundations.md` and emits one JSON per structural unit. It also rewrites the `foundations.*` entries in `paths-manifest.json` based on what it produced. See `foundations/src/AUTHORING.md` for the contributor-facing guide.

## Skipped sections

The derive script skips two H2 sections by slug — `handoff-protocol` and `related-guidelines` — because they're process docs / pointers, not design-system data. Edit `SKIP_H2_SLUGS` in `scripts/foundations/derive-foundations.js` to change this.
